summary: Iteration 6 — Kiosk portrait + auto-detect entry/exit. Verified end-to-end backend (12/12 pytest) and frontend (iPad portrait 820x1180). New endpoint GET /api/kiosk/next-type/{user_id} works with 404 handling; POST /api/kiosk/attendance/check auto-detects in/out when type is 'auto' or omitted, and remains backward-compatible for explicit 'in'/'out'. Frontend layout is portrait (aspect ratio 4/3 = 1.333, exactly aspect-[3/4]); bottom nav shows lock+PIN buttons side-by-side; header clock live; PIN flow shows kiosk-pin-type-badge with 'Próxima: ENTRADA' on first mark and 'Próxima: SALIDA' on the second (auto-detect verified end-to-end via PIN); success overlay renders 'entrada registrada'. Old data-testid kiosk-pin-in/kiosk-pin-out have been removed cleanly (0 occurrences). PIN input, PIN confirm/cancel, PIN picker, PIN search — all functional. Regression check: /api/kiosk/roster, /api/kiosk/unlock, /api/kiosk/verify-pin still work.

issues:
The Spanish date is displayed as 'Miércoles, 22 De Julio' — the CSS 'capitalize' class on the .font-serif-display

title-cases every word including the preposition 'de' which should stay lowercase in Spanish. Consider using a manual formatter (e.g., capitalize only weekday and month) or dropping the CSS 'capitalize' and relying on Intl output. Purely cosmetic; not a functional bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL COSMETIC: Fix 'De' → 'de' in the KioskScanPage date string (Spanish preposition should stay lowercase). Not a functional bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _resolve_next_type() is timezone-correct: it computes day_start from APP_TZ then converts back to UTC before comparing against timestamp — good.

KioskAttendanceIn.type Optional[Literal['in','out','auto']] with default 'auto' is safe; None branch (in the code `if effective_type in (None, 'auto')`) is defensive but never reached because pydantic will coerce missing field to default. Fine.
KioskScanPage.jsx confirmMark() correctly sends type='auto' so the race between UI-computed nextType and backend state is resolved server-side — excellent.

PinEnterDialog.useEffect resets pin on target change but does NOT cancel the in-flight /kiosk/next-type request. If a user cancels quickly and opens another user before first fetch resolves, the badge may briefly show the previous user's next_type. Minor race; not user-visible in practice.

KioskScanPage.jsx: the scan() interval keeps running while the matched Dialog is open (phaseRef.current === 'matched' → early return, good) but face-api still consumes CPU. This is fine for tablet kiosks.

Frontend: the 'capitalize' CSS on the date

title-cases Spanish prepositions ('De' instead of 'de'). Minor i18n cosmetic.
PinPickerDialog.max lists 60 users; roster with 17+ users is well within bounds. Not an issue.

kiosk-match-confirm and kiosk-pin-confirm both replace the previous dual buttons cleanly — no orphan data-testid references found (verified 0 occurrences of kiosk-pin-in/out and kiosk-match-in/out in DOM).

success_rate.frontend: 11/11 assertions (100%) — portrait aspect, bottom nav, clock, PIN picker, PIN search, user select, pin-type badge (ENTRADA), single confirm+cancel buttons, no old data-testid, PIN verify+attendance, success overlay, auto-detect switch to SALIDA on 2nd attempt
